sentences.12.5 Yrke: Jeg er pleieassistent: 12.5 Occupation: I am a care assistant
sentences.Jeg er pleieassistent og jobber på et sy: I am a care assistant and work in a nursing home.
sentences.Jeg hjelper eldre mennesker med vask, st: I help elderly people with washing, personal care and going to the toilet, and I dress them and serve them food.
sentences.Noen ganger går vi ut på tur, for beboer: Sometimes we go out for a walk, because the residents also need fresh air and exercise.
sentences.Jeg snakker mye med beboerne på sykehjem: I talk a lot with the residents at the nursing home.
sentences.Det er viktig å være god i muntlig norsk: It is important to be good at spoken Norwegian, because the residents need someone to talk to.
sentences.Det er også viktig å kunne ta imot beskj: It is also important to be able to take messages and work together with my colleagues at the nursing home.
sentences.God morgen, fru Olsen! Skal vi ta morgen: Good morning, Mrs Olsen! Shall we do your morning care?
sentences.God morgen! Jeg vil gjerne ha på meg den: Good morning! I'd like to wear this dress today.
sentences.Jeg tror ikke det. Det er kaldt i dag, o: I don't think so. It's cold today, and we're going out for a walk. You need to wear trousers.
sentences.Ja vel. Hva er det til frokost i dag?: All right. What's for breakfast today?
sentences.Du skal få en deilig havregrøt med frukt: You're getting a lovely bowl of porridge with fruit and berries. Later today your daughter and your grandchild are coming to visit.
sentences.Å, så hyggelig! Da vil jeg pynte meg. Ka: Oh, how nice! Then I want to dress up. Can you help me put on a bit of make-up?
sentences.En fastlege jobber på et legekontor og h: A GP works at a doctor's surgery and helps people who are ill.
sentences.En ambulansearbeider kjører pasienter ti: An ambulance worker drives patients to hospital in an ambulance.
sentences.En sykepleier gir medisiner og passer på: A nurse gives medicines and looks after the health of people who are ill.
sentences.Ei helsesøster passer på barn og unges h: A public health nurse looks after the health of children and young people and gives vaccinations.
sentences.En fysioterapeut hjelper pasienter med s: A physiotherapist helps patients with stiff and aching muscles.
